hooks.text: 单人到四人合作会按队伍人数动态调整挑战，任意人数配置都有独立奖励与平衡
hooks.excerpt: Enjoy the game solo or in co-op teams of up to four players – each option provides unique challenges and rewards. The game is designed to adjust to the number of players, ensuring a balanced and exciting contest in any combination.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 新War Mage各有专属武器、能力和陷阱，可独立作战也能与互补英雄组成协同队伍
hooks.excerpt: Find your role among new War Mages, each with unique weapons, abilities, traps, and personality. Each hero is tailored to different play styles and can operate independently or work together with complementing heroes, ensuring versatile and mighty orc-smashing.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 随机Buff与Debuff会同时改写英雄、陷阱、武器、数值和关卡，天气与昼夜也会改变敌人与防守选项
hooks.excerpt: Face intensifying waves of orcs and other hideous beasts with randomized buffs and debuffs that impact your hero, traps, weapons, stats, and the levels themselves. Environmental factors like weather and time of day further influence enemies and your defensive options. As these buffs and debuffs stack, choose to push forward against the growing hordes or return to your castle hub to power up your hero, weapons, and traps before facing a formidable Orc General in a brutal boss fight.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
